verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs say it is Apache 2.0 licensed and can be run locally or self-hosted, and the official CLI runs a Chroma server on your own machine. Community comments confirm a self-hostable open-source core with about 21k stars. One community comment notes that Chroma Cloud has better indexes (SPANN/SPFresh) and distributed scaling, which suggests the self-hosted core lacks some Cloud capabilities. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting deployment documentation (e.g. Docker/Kubernetes or production guides), evidence of feature parity with Cloud for distributed scaling and indexes, and hands-on self-hosting reports.
